generic_fallback_name: Early branching ground plant, inspired by Asteroxylon
purpose: Static stylized-inspired supporting prop for an imaginative children's world; artistic interpretation is welcome. No strict scientific reconstruction, animation readiness or current-museum integration is claimed.

subject.pose: Appealing static pose with separated defining parts; creative interpretation is permitted.
subject.life_stage: Stylized representative form, not an exact life-stage reconstruction.

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired original art. Basic identity should remain recognizable; color, texture, pose, proportions and harmless fine detail are creative choices. Use the generic fallback for deliberately loose interpretations.
coverage_justification: Six meaningful views at normal supported scale; add a targeted detail only for a real concern. No default orbit, bottom/wireframe campaign or microscopic perfection.
budget_context: Pilot ceilings, not targets. Joint texture caps apply; three maximum-size maps may exceed the decoded cap. Record actual counts and workload.
surface_profile: Refined low-poly with original artistic colors/textures/roughness; prioritize readable form without invisible microdetail.

scale.certainty: Approximate art-direction scale, not a new fossil measurement.
scale.origin: Ground/root contact center for plant; body-center mounting point for insect.
scale.coordinate_system: Author Z-up and -Y forward; export glTF Y-up and +Z forward.

artistic_choices_and_uncertainties: Colors, textures, appealing pose, proportions, cluster/shoot count and harmless fine details may be creative.
Incomplete exact fossil anatomy is advisory unless basic identity is unclear.
Cross-period curation is allowed in the labeled imaginative world.
Static prop only; no measured movement or rig readiness is claimed.

criteria.description: Validate the exact standalone GLB, clean reimport, dependencies, scale/origin and hard artifact limits; disposition warnings explicitly.

Recognizable basic form at supported viewing sizes, without obvious accidental missing/extra major parts or conspicuous unwanted intersections; artistic exaggeration and fine surface differences are allowed.

Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Differentiate connected leafy shoots, less-leafy root-bearing axes and thinner branching rooting axes below; avoid a fern rosette or modern tree construction.
Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Use simple small leaf-like enations along tapered, branching leafy shoots, leaving the main axis rhythm readable.

Stylized-inspired identity check, not strict fossil certification: Expose one edge of the connected basal network so shoot-bearing and rooting structure can be understood; avoid a disconnected decorative root tangle.

Editable blend, reproducible generator/config, exact standalone GLB, original maps where used, exact hashes, six QA views, one poster and honest inspired-by static-prop labels. Add actual source/generator/config deliverable hashes in a versioned execution brief.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds/material/texture metrics and errors.
Render and inspect this exact GLB in a declared graphics runtime. Record actual renderer/device and errors; software fallback must be labeled.
Inspect a neutral prop benchmark containing the exact GLB, with visible copy counts and measured work. This does not claim current-museum integration or scientific coexistence.

recovery.tests: No old QA is reused; validate recovered files anew.
